title: Personalized Homepage
meta: A homepage that shows each visitor products based on what they viewed, with safe defaults. From $200, delivered in 7 days or less.
h1: A personalized homepage for returning shoppers
overview: We set up your homepage so returning visitors see products related to what they browsed, while new visitors see your best sellers. We add sections such as recently viewed, picked for you and new in your favorite collection, with rules for what to show when there is no data. Sections match your theme, load fast and respect cookie choices. We test them as a new visitor and as a returning one, then show you how to adjust them.

pkgs.blurb: Recently viewed and best sellers on the home page.
Three personalized sections with fallback rules and a mobile check.
A full personalized home page with collection affinity and testing.
list: A and B test of one section

faq: Will each visitor see something different?
Returning visitors will, based on what they viewed on your store. New visitors see your best sellers or new arrivals. We set clear fallbacks, so the page never looks empty.
Only on site browsing, such as products viewed and collections visited, stored in line with your cookie banner. We do not buy data, track people across other sites or use sensitive details.
Will it work with my theme?
Most modern themes and builders support it. We check your theme first, tell you what is possible and use sections that match your fonts and colors. Heavily customized themes may need extra time.
Yes. Each section has a simple on and off switch, and we show you where. If you want to go back to a plain homepage, it takes a minute and nothing breaks.
